options.aba_desc.geral: Apply to the whole program, in every project.
options.aba_desc.ia: The AI key and the order in which Gemini models are used. If a model fails or hits its limit, the next one in the list is used.
options.aba_desc.projeto: Apply only to the open project and are saved inside its folder (.silent_projeto.json file), so they travel with the project in backups and syncs.
options.aba_desc.discord: The bot answers your players on Discord with the public lore of the open project. Secrets are always left out.
options.abrir_requisicoes_dica: When off, Improve, Adventure, Lore Checks, Statblock and Council requests go straight to the AI, with just a quick question.
options.ia_chave_dica: Get a key at aistudio.google.com ("Get API key"). It is kept in the Windows Credential Manager and takes effect immediately.
options.discord_conta_dica: The token comes from the Discord Developer Portal (see the Manual, section 13). Restart the program after changing the token so the bot connects.
options.discord_regras_dica: Pick a server to customize just that one; empty fields use the Global Default.
